data.title: 姬岛朱乃 · 露天温泉的湿身紫纱低语
data.description: 夜雾缭绕的露天秘境温泉中，天然岩石池水冒着温暖蒸汽。朱乃身上仅穿一件极薄的半透明深紫蕾丝晨袍斜靠在光滑石壁上，温水浸透薄纱紧紧吸附在胸脯与细腰上，粉嫩乳晕若隐若现。她的单手轻按在浸在水下的两腿之间，水珠顺着下巴与修长的锁骨滴落，微张樱唇发出按捺不住的甜美喘息——「啊啦……泡得太久，身体都要被热气化掉了……要不要进来，帮朱乃好好降一降温呢？」
data.location: 深山竹林深处的露天秘境温泉石池
data.action: 斜靠在温泉池壁边，浸水半透明紫纱吸附在娇躯上，单手在水面下自抚，眼神迷离微喘
data.lighting: 岩石旁竹制油灯与月色交织的光雾
data.promptProse: In a secluded open-air stone hot spring ringed by bamboo, Akeno leans back against the smooth rock edge as steam rises through the night air. Cool moonlight and warm bamboo lanterns glint off water droplets trailing down her collarbone.
data.animaCaption: Reclining against the wet hot-spring rocks in a soaked, translucent purple lace negligee clinging to her chest, she slips one hand beneath the steaming water between her thighs with parted lips.
data.nsfwProse: Her sheer violet silk negligee with black lace trim is soaked through and clings transparently over her chest and waist, while one hand rests submerged between her parted thighs.
